caption: The drawing features a single metallic object resembling a pair of scissors, rendered in a realistic style at the center of the composition. The scissors are depicted with brownish metallic handles and a combination of silver and rust-colored blades, with a circular mechanism at the midpoint, suggesting a specific function beyond ordinary scissors. The object casts a faint, soft-edged shadow to the right and below, indicating a light source from the upper left. The entire object is presented within a large, lightly outlined rectangle, and the artist’s name, "A. WALBECK," is signed in the bottom right corner of the outlined area. In the upper left corner of the image, there is a smaller, lightly sketched outline drawing of the same object at half its actual size, labeled "half actual size," while below the main central object, the text “actual size” is written. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white with minimal shading.
title: Candle Snuffer
